The opportunity cost of holding this much SCHD is massive.  I have a hard time believing any investor would own this much SCHD,  unless their portfolio is much, much bigger.  Naturally,  the stage of life and related living expenses are key determinants of how someone would utilize SCHD.  I see very little reason to hold this ETF until the individual is approaching retirement,  and even then,  I cannot understand how an investor would think that 600k in their portfolio is a efficacious use of resources.  If the 600k of SCHD is your only investment,  you are going to receive #18,408 a year.  Unless you have significant other income sources,  like a higher than average Social Security check,  or live an extremely frugal lifestyle,  SCHD is not the tent pole you want holding up your life.  If you deploy the 600k entirely into income funds,  you could possibly receive $48,000 to $102,000 a year.  With the right ETFs,  almost all of that income would go untaxed for 7-12 years.  But if $18,408 was all the additional income you needed,  an ETF like TDAQ could provide that with as little as $108,282.  The remaining $491,718 could be deployed into a basket of ETFs for growth, value and extra income.  That basket could certainly include SCHD,  which I would only hold as a value play because there are far better ETFs for growth and income.  Don't let 2026 fool you.
